name: Guided Assistance
subtitle: Your private document assistant
localizedDescription: Build a private knowledge base from your own PDFs, text files, and Markdown. Browse reusable request guides, capture dated updates with revision history, and ask optional on-device AI for answers with source passages. Your documents remain in local device storage. The app starts empty and does not include work documents. Local chat uses an optional approximately 3 GB Qwen3.5 4B model download; model speed and memory use vary by device. Search and guides work without the model. Includes device authentication and passphrase-encrypted exports for manual transfer. For AltStore Classic on iPhone and iPad with iOS 18 or newer.

privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Unlock your private document knowledge base.
